newsitem.title: USA: Fresh Juice sees FY loss $800,000-$1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Fresh Juice sees FY loss $800,000-$1 mln.

text.p: Fresh Juice Co Inc said on Monday that it expected to post a loss of $800,000 to $1.1 million for the fiscal year ended November 30, 1996.

The loss will reflect increased labor costs and expenses related to consolidation of Clear Springs Citrus Inc and full integration of its Winter Haven, Florida, facility, said Fresh Juice, which is delaying its annual report.
In the year ended November 1995, the company reported revenues of $9.2 million and net income of $200,000.
